answer_1.quote: We present a new method of open‑domain dialogue evaluation based on human assessment of live conversations with models ...

answer_2.quote: We employed four prevailing word‑overlap‑based metrics ... BLEU, ROUGE‑L, METEOR, GLEU ... and two reference‑free automatic metrics ... FED and USR.

answer_3.quote: FED (Fine‑grained Evaluation of Dialog) is a pre‑trained‑model based metric ... We employed medium and large DialoGPT as FED scorers ... USR uses the pre‑trained model RoBERTa to assess the quality of a conversation.

answer_4.quote: Hits were posted on the crowd‑sourcing platform Amazon Mechanical Turk ... workers converse with each model before rating the quality of the conversation ... We ask judges to rate each conversation under the seven aforementioned measurement criteria (Figure) along with a continuous rating scale.
answer_4.guideline: Workers rate each conversation on a continuous 0‑100 scale for each criterion after the live chat.
